name: Deliberation Engine
description: A reusable deliberation engine in which people exchange reasons, revise views, propose a conclusion, and vote. Each member's view blends where they started with the average stance of the speeches made so far, so views move during the debate and the vote can go either way without the group being talked into unanimity. A speech's stance is what a bound judge host ('judge') reads in its words (direction times strength); without one, coded listeners react to the speaker's own stance, not to what is said.

brief.rules: Members may speak, propose a conclusion, second it, amend it, signal readiness, call the question, and vote. Every speech can move each listener's stance toward the speaker's, while members keep part of their starting view. The purpose is reasoned view revision rather than role-specific institutional procedure.

roles.member: Contribute your perspective, listen to reasons, revise when warranted, and vote according to your considered judgment.

question.default: Should the group adopt the proposed course of action?

persuasion.description: Average share of a member's view that comes from the speeches made rather than their starting stance (each member draws between 0 and twice this); 0 = nobody changes their mind.

default.name: Member 4
default.perspective: Worries about the cost and who bears it.

default.name: Member 5
default.perspective: Undecided; wants to hear the arguments first.

default.name: Member 9
default.perspective: Cares about fairness of the process.

default.name: Member 11
default.perspective: Doubts it will work in practice.

heard.description: Entries of the forum record whose persuasion has been applied.

said.description: Sum of the speeches' stances over every speech made.

stance.description: Current view, from -1 (against) to 1 (for); speeches move it.

initial_stance.description: Where the member started; their view stays partly anchored to it.

openness.description: Share of the member's view that comes from the speeches made.

spoke_on.description: The motion this member last spoke on (null before their first speech on a motion).

private_view.show: Your current stance is {stance|2}. Your perspective: {perspective}

outcome.description: passed, rejected, or status_quo when nothing came to a vote.

speech_stance.description: Where a speech pulls its listeners: the bound judge's reading of its words, else the speaker's own stance.

speech_judge.instructions: Read one speech made in a debate on the question given with it. Score which way it argues and how persuasive it is to a thoughtful listener, on its words alone.

direction.description: Which way the speech argues on the question: -1 firmly against, 0 neutral or mixed, 1 firmly for.

strength.description: How persuasive the speech is: 0 not at all, 1 compelling.
